project_dashboard.name: Project Dashboard
values: HOME CONSTRUCTION COST PLAN — GROUND + FIRST FLOOR
Use Daily Expenses for actuals by category
Update the contingency % on Project Setup
1. Start in Project Setup: enter contingency %, floors, target dates and notes.
2. Fill quantities and your local rates in Materials & BOQ, Labour & Work, Professional Fees, and Misc & Equipment.
3. Use Daily Expenses for date-wise payments/purchases. Enter each bill/payment as a separate row.
4. Use Quotation Compare to compare up to 4 vendors item-by-item before selecting a supplier.
5. Use Work Schedule to plan dates, responsible person, progress and dependencies for each construction activity.
6. Keep bills, measurement book, drawings and engineer-approved quantities as your source of truth.
See the 'Detailed Material List' sheet for separate rows for cement, steel, bricks/blocks, sand, aggregate, plumbing, electrical, tiles, paint, doors/windows and external works.
